meaning: Source/document review attestations, not proof of semantic correctness or issue completion.

agents.review_note: Reviewed official Google typed RetryInfo and QuotaFailure, Vercel AI SDK step telemetry and OpenTelemetry error conventions; native bounded metadata, exact delay and tool-continuation tests; direct advertised-tool prompt guidance.

auth.review_note: Canonical configured username or email matches only the existing owner identity, still requiring password_verify. No credential changes or default password introduced.

commerce.review_note: Reviewed backend skill and commerce data contracts; read-only model-selected facts do not change payment, order, catalogue or checkout writes.

content.review_note: Reviewed browser snapshot bounds, per-owner and page key, revision conflict, explicit save token cleanup and unchanged MySQL CAS and publication status.

foundation.review_note: Reviewed the isolated file-validation regression and existing settings persistence. Brand uploads reuse the ordinary media store and do not change schema or hosting prerequisites.

google-tags.review_note: Reviewed the owner settings guide and site head. Brand favicon fallback is independent of Google IDs and authorization.

http-errors.review_note: Checked the common layout and controller feedback against the HTTP response boundary. The appearance redirect reports failed writes without provider details.

interface.review_note: Compared the real 1280 and 375 px previews, labels and failure messages with the appearance design and owner help.

mail.review_note: Compared the appearance-only controller change to mail and authentication routes. The handler stores brand settings and audit events without using SMTP.

mcp-clients.review_note: Reviewed the shared site layout and settings guide. Brand-only favicon fallback does not change MCP client grants, prerequisites or URLs.

media.review_note: Checked format, size and storage controls, original favicon format and existing media deletion references against the host persistence contract.

operator-help.review_note: Compared the active brand preview, file limits, persistent library storage and failure handling with the owner settings guide.

public-mcp.review_note: Checked the route inventory. The MediaService relation describes an existing owner appearance POST and introduces no public tool.

remote-commerce.review_note: Compared the shared layout and Design.md change with checkout and cart guidance. Appearance still uses a distinct owner form and does not touch commerce state.

sales-channels.review_note: Confirmed the existing catalogue optimiser and filename handling remain the default. Only brand uploads retain the original raster type.

workflow.review_note: Reviewed the declared MediaService route relationship and admin testing guidance. The workflow still uses the same route, store and browser verification.
